name: Campus Open Spaces and Landscape Services
description: Faithful replication of Tudorie, Vallés-Planells, Gielen, Arroyo & Galiana (2020), "Towards a Greener University: Perceptions of Landscape Services in Campus Open Space", Sustainability 12:6047. Participants see four photographs of campus open spaces at the Universitat Politècnica de València, Spain (atrium, garden, green verge, park). For each they rate liking (1 "I do not like it at all" to 5 "I like it a lot") and agreement with six attributes (beautiful, natural, maintained, cheerful, useful for environmental functions, important for the campus image; 1–5). For the green verge and the park they also select the landscape services the space provides (15 options, Table 12). They then rate the general state and management of campus open spaces, select needs (12 options, Figure 4), rate how well campus open spaces provide 14 landscape services (1 very poor to 5 excellent), and give age, sex, occupation, branch of knowledge, time at the university and frequency of open-space use. Analysis as in the paper: descriptive percentages, Kruskal–Wallis and Mann–Whitney tests between user groups. Photographs: the paper's own (Figure 3, CC BY 4.0), used with credit; the template is removed if the authors object. Differences from the original study: (1) the full questionnaire is not printed, so wording is rebuilt from the method text, Tables 1, 5, 9 and 12 and Figure 4; the sixth attribute "cheerful" comes from Table 9; (2) satisfaction is asked as good / neutral / bad, the categories the paper reports; (3) the needs and landscape-service options are the categories reported in the results; (4) the panel letters in the figure were removed (top strip cropped for garden, green verge and park; sky filled for atrium); (5) the original trap questions and open-ended questions are not included; (6) English instead of Spanish.
author: Tudorie, Vallés-Planells, Gielen, Arroyo & Galiana

pages.name: intro
pages.intro: Campus open spaces are the outdoor areas of the university campus: squares, gardens, parks, green strips and paths between buildings. This survey asks how you see and use them, to help plan a greener campus. It takes about 10 minutes. There are no incentives; answers are anonymous and used for research only.

<style>
:root{--bg:#f0f3ec;--card:#fff;--ink:#1e231b;--muted:#596253;--accent:#3d6e2a;--line:#d3dbcc;--warn:#b3261e}
*{box-sizing:border-box}html,body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font:16px/1.5 system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif}
main{max-width:820px;margin:0 auto;padding:20px 16px 40px}
h1{font-size:1.3rem;margin:0 0 10px}
p{margin:0 0 12px;color:var(--muted)}
.card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:16px;margin-top:14px}
.btn{appearance:none;border:0;border-radius:10px;padding:12px 20px;font:inherit;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;background:var(--accent);color:#fff}
.btn.sec{background:transparent;color:var(--accent);border:1px solid var(--line);padding:8px 14px;font-size:.9rem}
.btn:disabled{opacity:.4;cursor:not-allowed}
.q{margin-top:22px}.q:first-child{margin-top:0}.q>b{display:block;margin-bottom:6px}
.q.miss>b{color:var(--warn)}
.hint{font-size:.85rem;color:var(--muted);margin:-2px 0 6px}
label.opt{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;padding:8px 12px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;margin-top:6px;cursor:pointer;background:var(--card)}
textarea,input[type=text]{font:inherit;padding:8px 10px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;width:100%}
textarea{min-height:84px;resize:vertical}
.top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:8px}
.t{color:var(--muted);font-size:.9rem}
.bar{height:5px;background:var(--line);border-radius:3px;overflow:hidden;flex:1;margin-left:12px;max-width:260px}.bar>i{display:block;height:100%;background:var(--accent)}
.it{padding:10px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}.it:first-of-type{border-top:0}.it.miss>div:first-child{color:var(--warn)}
.it>div:first-child{margin-bottom:6px}
.seg{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(var(--n),minmax(0,1fr));gap:3px;max-width:480px}
.seg label{display:block;cursor:pointer;position:relative}
.seg input{position:absolute;opacity:0;pointer-events:none}
.seg span{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;min-height:40px;padding:2px 4px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;font-size:.85rem}
.seg input:checked+span{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);color:#fff}
.seg input:focus-visible+span{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:2px}
.imgs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(220px,1fr));gap:14px}
.imgs img,.tile img{width:100%;aspect-ratio:1/1;object-fit:cover;border-radius:8px;display:block}
.cap{font-size:.9rem;margin:6px 0}
.rank{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr));gap:8px;margin-top:10px}
.tile{position:relative;border:2px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer;background:#fff;padding:0;font:inherit;text-align:center}
.tile img{border-radius:0}.tile small{display:block;padding:4px 3px;font-size:.76rem;line-height:1.25}
.tile.on{border-color:var(--accent)}
.tile .n{position:absolute;top:6px;left:6px;min-width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:15px;background:var(--accent);color:#fff;font-weight:700;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.err{color:var(--warn);margin-top:8px;min-height:1.2em}
.credit{max-width:820px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 16px 24px;font-size:.78rem;color:var(--muted)}
@media (max-width:600px){.rank{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}}
.pic{background:#e7ebe4;border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;margin-bottom:12px}.pic img{width:100%;max-height:min(55vh,480px);object-fit:contain;display:block}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<main id="app" aria-live="polite"><p>Loading…</p></main>
<footer class="credit">Photographs: Tudorie, Vallés-Planells, Gielen, Arroyo & Galiana (2020), Sustainability 12:6047, Figure 3, doi:10.3390/su12156047 (CC BY 4.0; open spaces on the campus of the Universitat Politècnica de València, Spain). Used with credit for research; removed if the authors object.</footer>
<script>
(function(){
  var KEY='upvcampus2020:';
  var app=document.getElementById('app'), Q={}, files={}, done={}, A={}, PAGES=[];
  function esc(s){return String(s==null?'':s).replace(/[&<>"]/g,function(c){return {'&':'&','<':'<','>':'>','"':'"'}[c];});}
  function err(m){var e=app.querySelector('.err');if(e){e.textContent=m||'';e.style.visibility='visible';}}
  function hideErr(){var e=app.querySelector('.err');if(e)e.style.visibility='hidden';}
  function ok(r){return !(r&&r.ok===false);}
  function load(k){try{return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY+k));}catch(e){return null;}}
  function save(k,v){try{localStorage.setItem(KEY+k,JSON.stringify(v));}catch(e){}}
  function vis(e){var c=e.visibleIf;if(!c)return true;var v=A[c.q];if(c.eq!=null)return v===c.eq;if(c.in)return c.in.indexOf(v)>=0;if(c.has)return Array.isArray(v)&&v.indexOf(c.has)>=0;return true;}
  function pageVis(p){return p.elements.some(vis);}
  function next(){window.scrollTo(0,0);for(var i=0;i<PAGES.length;i++){var p=PAGES[i];if(!done[p.name]&&pageVis(p))return render(p,i);}finish();}
  function seg(name,cols){return '<div class="seg" style="--n:'+cols.length+'" role="radiogroup">'+cols.map(function(c){return '<label><input type="radio" name="'+esc(name)+'" value="'+esc(c.value)+'"><span>'+esc(c.text)+'</span></label>';}).join('')+'</div>';}
  function el(e,i){
    var h='<div class="q" data-q="'+e.name+'"><b>'+esc(e.title)+(e.isRequired?'':' <span class="t">(optional)</span>')+'</b>'+(e.hint?'<div class="hint">'+esc(e.hint)+'</div>':'');
    if(e.type==='boolean')h+='<label class="opt"><input type="checkbox" name="'+e.name+'" value="1"> '+esc(e.label||'Yes')+'</label>';
    else if(e.type==='radiogroup')h+=e.choices.map(function(c){return '<label class="opt"><input type="radio" name="'+e.name+'" value="'+c.value+'"> '+esc(c.text)+'</label>';}).join('');
    else if(e.type==='checkbox')h+=e.choices.map(function(c){return '<label class="opt"><input type="checkbox" name="'+e.name+'" value="'+c.value+'"> '+esc(c.text)+'</label>';}).join('');
    else if(e.type==='comment')h+='<textarea name="'+e.name+'" maxlength="2000"></textarea>';
    else if(e.type==='text')h+='<input type="text" name="'+e.name+'" maxlength="200">';
    else if(e.kind==='matrix')h+=e.items.map(function(it){return '<div class="it" data-n="'+it.name+'"><div>'+esc(it.text)+'</div>'+seg(e.name+'__'+it.name,e.scale)+'</div>';}).join('');
    else if(e.kind==='image_rating')h+='<div class="imgs">'+e.items.map(function(it){return '<div class="it" data-n="'+it.name+'" style="border:0;padding:0"><img alt="'+esc(it.text)+'" src="'+esc(files[it.file].url)+'"><div class="cap">'+esc(it.text)+'</div>'+seg(e.name+'__'+it.name,e.scale)+'</div>';}).join('')+'</div>';
    else if(e.kind==='image_rank')h+='<div class="rank"></div><p class="status" style="margin-top:10px;color:var(--ink)"></p><button type="button" class="btn sec rreset">Start over</button>';
    return h+'</div>';
  }
  function render(p,i){
    var els=p.elements.filter(vis),order={};
    app.innerHTML='<div class="top"><span class="t">Page '+(i+1)+' of '+PAGES.length+'</span><div class="bar"><i style="width:'+(100*i/PAGES.length)+'%"></i></div></div>'+(p.title?'<h1>'+esc(p.title)+'</h1>':'')+'<div class="card">'+(p.image&&files[p.image]?'<div class="pic"><img alt="'+esc(p.imageAlt||'Photograph')+'" src="'+esc(files[p.image].url)+'"></div>':'')+(p.intro?'<p style="color:var(--ink)">'+esc(p.intro)+'</p>':'')+els.map(el).join('')+'</div><div style="margin-top:18px"><button class="btn" id="go">'+(i===PAGES.length-1?'Finish':'Next')+'</button></div><div class="err"></div>';
    app.onchange=function(ev){hideErr();var it=ev.target.closest('.it');if(it)it.classList.remove('miss');var qq=ev.target.closest('.q');if(qq)qq.classList.remove('miss');var e2=Q[qq&&qq.getAttribute('data-q')];if(e2&&e2.reflow){A[e2.name]=readOne(e2,true);var keep=collect();render(p,i);restore(keep);}};
    els.forEach(function(e){if(e.kind==='image_rank'){order[e.name]=[];drawRank(e,order);}});
    restore(load('draft_'+p.name));
    document.getElementById('go').onclick=function(){
      var l=[],bad=null;
      for(var k=0;k<els.length;k++){var e=els[k],v=e.kind==='image_rank'?rankVal(e,order):readOne(e);
        if(v===undefined){if(e.isRequired){bad=bad||e;var qq=app.querySelector('.q[data-q="'+e.name+'"]');qq.classList.add('miss');}continue;}
        l.push([e.name,v]);}
      if(bad){err(bad.kind==='image_rank'?'Please rank all five lawn types.':(bad.kind?'Please answer every row of: ':'Please answer: ')+(bad.kind==='image_rank'?'':bad.title));var m=app.querySelector('.q.miss');if(m)m.scrollIntoView({block:'center'});return;}
      var b=this;b.disabled=true;
      Promise.all(l.map(function(a){A[a[0]]=a[1];var ee=Q[a[0]];return ee&&ee.shownFile&&files[ee.shownFile]?SPSite.answer(a[0],a[1],{shown:[files[ee.shownFile].name]}):SPSite.answer(a[0],a[1]);})).then(function(rs){var x=rs.filter(function(r){return !ok(r);})[0];if(x){b.disabled=false;return err(x.error);}done[p.name]=true;save('d',done);next();});
    };
  }
  function collect(){var o={};[].forEach.call(app.querySelectorAll('input,textarea'),function(x){if(x.type==='radio'||x.type==='checkbox'){if(x.checked)(o[x.name]=o[x.name]||[]).push(x.value);}else o[x.name]=x.value;});return o;}
  function restore(o){if(!o)return;[].forEach.call(app.querySelectorAll('input,textarea'),function(x){var v=o[x.name];if(v==null)return;if(x.type==='radio'||x.type==='checkbox')x.checked=v.indexOf(x.value)>=0;else x.value=v;});}
  function readOne(e,soft){
    if(e.type==='boolean'){return app.querySelector('input[name="'+e.name+'"]').checked?true:undefined;}
    if(e.type==='radiogroup'){var x=app.querySelector('input[name="'+e.name+'"]:checked');return x?Number(x.value):undefined;}
    if(e.type==='checkbox'){var xs=[].map.call(app.querySelectorAll('input[name="'+e.name+'"]:checked'),function(x){return Number(x.value);});return xs.length?xs:undefined;}
    if(e.type==='comment'||e.type==='text'){var t=app.querySelector('[name="'+e.name+'"]').value.trim();return t?t:undefined;}
    if(e.kind==='matrix'||e.kind==='image_rating'){var v={},miss=0;e.items.forEach(function(it){var x=app.querySelector('input[name="'+e.name+'__'+it.name+'"]:checked');if(x)v[it.name]=Number(x.value);else if(!it.optional){miss++;var d=app.querySelector('.q[data-q="'+e.name+'"] .it[data-n="'+it.name+'"]');if(d&&!soft)d.classList.add('miss');}});return miss?undefined:v;}
  }
  function rankVal(e,order){var o=order[e.name];if(o.length<e.items.length)return undefined;var v={};o.forEach(function(n,i){v[n]=i+1;});return v;}
  function drawRank(e,order){
    var box=app.querySelector('.q[data-q="'+e.name+'"]'),g=box.querySelector('.rank'),o=order[e.name];
    g.innerHTML=e.items.map(function(it){var p=o.indexOf(it.name);return '<button type="button" class="tile'+(p>=0?' on':'')+'" data-v="'+it.name+'"><img alt="'+esc(it.text)+'" src="'+esc(files[it.file].url)+'">'+(p>=0?'<span class="n">'+(p+1)+'</span>':'')+'<small>'+esc(it.text)+'</small></button>';}).join('');
    box.querySelector('.status').textContent=o.length?('Your order: '+o.map(function(n){return e.items.filter(function(it){return it.name===n;})[0].text;}).join(' > ')):'Tap your most preferred lawn type first (1), then the next, down to the least preferred (5). Tap a numbered photo to undo it.';
    [].forEach.call(g.querySelectorAll('.tile'),function(t){t.onclick=function(){var v=t.getAttribute('data-v'),p=o.indexOf(v);if(p>=0)o.splice(p,1);else o.push(v);hideErr();box.classList.remove('miss');drawRank(e,order);};});
    box.querySelector('.rreset').onclick=function(){o.length=0;drawRank(e,order);};
  }
  function finish(){
    app.innerHTML='<h1>Thank you!</h1><div class="card"><p>In the original survey of 786 members of the university community in Valencia, almost everyone liked the garden (97%) and the park (90%), while only a third liked the green verge and about one in nine the paved atrium. Natural shade, water, trees, and tables and benches were the most requested improvements.</p><p style="font-size:.82rem">Tudorie, C.A.-M., Vallés-Planells, M., Gielen, E., Arroyo, R., & Galiana, F. (2020). Towards a Greener University: Perceptions of Landscape Services in Campus Open Space. Sustainability 12:6047, doi:10.3390/su12156047.</p><p id="fin">Submitting…</p><div class="err"></div></div>';
    SPSite.complete().then(function(r){if(!ok(r)){err(r.error||'Some answers are missing.');var m=r.missing||[];setTimeout(function(){PAGES.forEach(function(p){if(p.elements.some(function(e){return m.indexOf(e.name)>=0;}))done[p.name]=false;});save('d',done);next();},1800);}
      else{var s=document.getElementById('fin');if(s)s.textContent='Your answers have been saved. You can close this window now.';}});
  }
  SPSite.onReady(function(ctx){
    var S;try{S=JSON.parse(document.getElementById('sp-scheme').textContent).survey;}catch(e){S={pages:[]};}
    PAGES=S.pages;PAGES.forEach(function(p){p.elements.forEach(function(e){var g=SPSite.getQuestion(e.name)||{};if(g.title)e.title=g.title;Q[e.name]=e;});});
    (SPSite.getMedia('campus')||[]).forEach(function(f){files[f.name]=f;});
    if(['atrium.jpg','garden.jpg','green_verge.jpg','park.jpg'].some(function(n){return !files[n];})){app.innerHTML='<h1>Photographs missing</h1><p>Media folder campus must hold atrium.jpg, garden.jpg, green_verge.jpg and park.jpg.</p>';return;}
    A=(ctx&&ctx.answers)||{};done=load('d')||{};
    PAGES.forEach(function(p){done[p.name]=p.elements.filter(function(e){return e.isRequired&&vis(e);}).every(function(e){return A[e.name]!=null;})&&p.elements.some(function(e){return A[e.name]!=null;});});
    next();
  });
})();
</script>
</body>
